name: LidLid blue guardian
design: Original blue plush guardian propping up a generic laptop; vivid blue, neutral soft light, no orange side glow.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create a visibly BOLDER redesign of this original LidLid icon, not a tiny retouch. Keep the recognizable blue plush creature with its two glossy black bead eyes, upper-right soft fold, and tiny integrated paws holding up an almost-closing laptop. No mouth or accessories.

ART DIRECTION: a striking designer mascot icon with exaggerated soft sculptural proportions. The blue creature becomes much more prominent, a buoyant rounded cushion with a playful asymmetric lean and a big puffy cheek, looking confidently and curiously at the viewer. Its body bulges forward over the keyboard front, while two tiny paw nubs firmly support the lid above. Make the little upper-right folded ridge a crisp recognizable sculptural feature. Two small dark eyes stay close-set with a subtle diagonal eye-line and restrained tiny white catchlights. Not a generic smiling monster, no huge cartoon eyes. Soft tactile short blue plush, clear clean silhouette. More saturated fresh cobalt/cornflower BLUE with soft periwinkle shading; no green.

Rebalance the composition aggressively toward the character: the blue face/body occupies about TWO THIRDS of the central scene, with the simple charcoal laptop becoming a compact supporting frame. The lid is a strong clean diagonal canopy over its head, both paws visibly touching that rim. Keep a recognizable full laptop: wide display, thin keyboard base, simple trackpad and TWO separated rear hinges, structurally correct. Enlarge the hero without hiding the meaning. Simplify laptop details and use chunky rounded illustrated edges, not a realistic product photo. Mild front three-quarter perspective, dynamic but physically plausible. Whole scene comfortably inside about 9% margins. The bold silhouette should remain readable as an app icon at 64px.

CRITICAL LIGHTING CHANGE: COMPLETELY REMOVE the orange/yellow glowing outline on the LEFT side of the reference and all warm rim lighting on either side. NO orange highlights, no edge glow, no backlight, no side flare, no bright strip along the left laptop bezel or the creature's left cheek. Use large EVEN NEUTRAL FRONTAL softbox illumination, balanced left and right. Matte charcoal laptop with controlled broad subtle reflections. Gentle local contact shadows only. This must look clean, soft and evenly illuminated, not cinematically side-lit.

Background is a quiet solid pale ivory-white, evenly lit, no orange gradient, no color bloom or spotlight behind it. Premium contemporary 3D character icon, punchy blue versus ink-grey and pale background, expressive proportions rather than lighting effects.
One square opaque full-bleed artwork with no pre-rounded outer corners, no text, logos, Apple hardware replica, third-party mascot, badges, extra objects, sparkles or watermark.
exports: scripts/export-brand-assets.swift produces the legacy macOS iconset and public website/documentation assets. The unmasked opaque 1024px master is used for the Store artwork export.
